body: Train transformer language models with reinforcement learning.
plain_description: **Post-train foundation models with reinforcement learning and preference feedback.** Use ready-made trainers or a command-line interface for common training methods. Scale training across GPUs and clusters.
technical_description: TRL is a Python library for post-training transformer foundation models. It provides trainers for supervised fine-tuning, GRPO, DPO, KTO, and reward modeling, plus a CLI. It builds on Transformers and supports distributed training through Accelerate, DDP, DeepSpeed, and FSDP. PEFT integration supports LoRA/QLoRA, and AsyncGRPOTrainer can use a vLLM server for generation.
title: TRL
